config.notes: Griffith course pages (www.griffith.edu.au/study/degrees/<slug>-<code>), one per program, international view. Text only, no page data. Key facts block: "Campus <list> Duration <n year s full-time> Commencing in Trimester 1, 2[, 3] Credit points ... Degree code .. Cricos code .. Entry requirements IELTS (Academic) <n> ... Fee (INDICATIVE) $<n> [per year] <year> indicative annual fee" (certificates show the 40 CP annual figure without "per year"). Start terms also read from the degree-structure selector ("Select when you are planning to start studying ... Trimester 1 Trimester 2") and "Next intake Trimester n <year>". Trimester to month = orientation month, from Griffith academic calendar (https://www.griffith.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0036/1475757/2027-Academic-Calendar.pdf, 2026 version /0034/1475755/) and the course pages ("Trimester 1 2027 Orientation commences 22 February 2027", "Trimester 3 2026 Orientation commences 26 October 2026"): Trimester 1 = February, Trimester 2 = July (orientation 6-10 July 2026, 5-9 July 2027), Trimester 3 = October. Keys "1, 2"/"2, 3"/"1, 3" only expand the page list form "Trimester 1, 2, 3". Delivery (mode): the international-view Key facts Campus line, kept with its Campus label so a physical campus reads as on campus and Online as online; a line that is only Online is read as Online. Exit awards: the Exit Point(s) section prints each exit award with credit points only (e.g. "To be eligible to exit with the 3346 - Graduate Certificate in Integrated Water Management, you must successfully complete 40 credit points"); the pattern keeps these sentences for review. The same pages state the full-time year: "standard full-time study load which is usually 80 credit points or 40 credit points for certificate programs (two full-time trimesters)", so years = credit points / 80. Exit awards are set by hand (admin_exit_awards set) only for catalogue courses with no values of their own. Entry requirement (for review, not admitted): the Prerequisites / Assumed knowledge line of Key facts. No whole-course fees: every course page prints an annual figure, so no fee_total.
